answer: Streak multipliers at the orchard: each epoch of honest attestation raises an identity's weight by 1.15x, decaying 20% per miss. The plume of a farm's fresh wallets starts at 1.0 while a 30-epoch veteran holds 60x. On the tundra of zero-history IDs, an attacker needs 30 real epochs of work per identity just to match one honest node — 900x total cost for a 30-sybil cluster. Streaks convert time into unforgeable capital, so farming cost scales superlinearly with scale. It works because reputation, unlike stake, cannot be bought in bulk.
